Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Our security team finished reviewing the materials you sent and had two follow-ups: one, can you provide the formal SOC 2 Type II report (redacted is fine) covering Feb 1 2025 - Jan 31 2026? Two, during the review they flagged the two control exceptions you mentioned on the call (user access review gaps and a flaky CI/CD rollback control). They asked for:  

- the official management response(s) to those exceptions,
- current remediation status and expected closure dates, and
- a bridge letter if the audit period doesn't fully cover the fixes.

Could you send those artifacts or let us know an ETA? We need to present to procurement on Tuesday. If you prefer, we can accept a short consolidated note + attachments.

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear ask. I pushed this into our security queue and summarized next steps below. Short version: we can provide a redacted Type II report today, a draft bridge letter, and a remediation tracker with target close dates. Rishi (security lead) will own the remediation detail. Monica (CFO) is looped for the official bridge-letter signature authority.

What we'll deliver (ETA = today unless noted):
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted PII) — attachment: SOC2_TypeII_202402-redacted.pdf (attached)
- Draft bridge letter explaining audit window and how fixes map to controls — attachment: bridge_letter_draft.docx (please review; Monica can sign)
- Remediation tracker with owners and target close dates — attachment: remediation_plan_q2.xlsx (Rishi filled in status)
- Short management response text for each exception (pasted below) — for your review and acceptance into your packet

Management responses (summary):
1) User access review exception — We acknowledge that periodic entitlement reviews were not completed consistently for one quarter due to tooling migration. We have implemented an automated monthly entitlement report (deployed 2026-02-20) and assigned control owner Priya Natarajan to run quarterly attestations. Target remediation: 2026-04-15.

2) CI/CD rollback control intermittent failure — Root cause was a flaky helm hook in our canary rollback path; fix deployed 2026-03-08 and we added synthetic rollback tests to CI. Target remediation: 2026-03-22 (validation window).

If that timeline works, Monica can sign the bridge letter and we can send via DocuSign. Rishi — can you confirm the validation windows and whether any evidence (runbooks, screenshots, logs) will be ready for handoff?

Jordan — let me know if you prefer a single bundled ZIP or separate attachments per item.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
